## e) WHAT WE SHOULD IMPROVE

- **Sweep per CLASS, not instance:** when a stale pin is found, grep the whole file (and siblings) for the same pin class before declaring victory.
- **Use nix for missing tools immediately** — "not on PATH" is never an excuse in a nix shop.
- **Don't create new split brains while fixing old ones** — 3 copies of one function is the exact anti-pattern this repo's docs rail against; lib-ify.
- **Queue owner-gated decisions into TODO files, not prose** — AGENTS notes are memory, TODO rows are dispatch.
- **Label evidence strength:** "verified in-file" vs "per doctrine" must be distinguishable at read time.
